description: Financial statement filing timeliness from KRS register entries (date each annual statement was filed) and the Financial Document Repository: for each recent financial year the period end, filing date, statutory deadline (year end + 6 months + 15 days), days late or not filed, and whether a statutory auditor's report was filed. Also overdue_year when the latest statement is past its deadline and missing, and late_last_5y. Keyed by KRS; null when the company has never filed.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.
